metadata.title: An explicit rank-two entropy-minimizing Fano degeneration
metadata.description:
We give an explicit smooth Fano fivefold whose unique global Han–Li entropy-minimizing valuation has rational rank two and is therefore nondivisorial. Its canonical first central variety is singular, so this first degeneration is nontrivial. The example is the product of Miao–Wang’s established quadric-blowup threefold with the first Hirzebruch surface. Exact moment equations specify the two positive weights. A universal resultant argument and the classical Hermite–Lindemann theorem prove that their ratio is irrational. The associated graded anticanonical ring, canonical weight normalization, weak product soliton equation, and application of the established global optimality criterion are made explicit.

The construction satisfies the request discussed by Blum in Oberwolfach Report 17/2022, pp. 888–889, without a dimension bound or a product exclusion. Major inputs are due to Miao–Wang, Wang–Zhu, Han–Li, and Blum–Liu–Xu–Zhuang. Earlier nontrivial first centers of Li–Li are credited; their second example’s rational rank was not certified in the sources inspected. The threefold factor was already announced in Miao–Wang’s January 2024 preprint. No novelty, historical firstness, exhaustive priority, or continued-openness certificate is claimed.

AI tools were used extensively in developing, checking, and preparing the work. The reported adversarial reviews were performed by AI agents. This is an unrefereed preprint; independent human peer review and formal verification have not been completed. The accompanying verification archive preserves original proof and correction bytes, source fingerprints, bounded priority audits, adversarial analyses, and exact auxiliary diagnostics. Passing software checks does not formally verify the geometric or analytic theorem inputs.
